verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs say it ships first-party modules for forms that work together with the rest of the platform, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is a single marketing-level line, though, and nothing describes form validation, the forms APIs, or how they integrate. Missing for 10: documented form validation capabilities, detailed forms API documentation (reactive/template-driven), independent or hands-on corroboration of forms integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use first-party modules for building and validating forms that integrate with the rest of the framework

citations.quote: Fully featured platform where everything works together with Angular's first-party modules for forms, routing, and more
